feed.title: Blog — Ponos
feed.subtitle: Notes from the people who build Ponos: how it runs Claude Code on a backlog, and what we learn doing it.

entry.title: Steer a running Claude Code session, rewind it to any step, schedule tickets for later: what's new in Ponos
entry.summary: Correct a Claude Code session while it works, start a ticket again from the step where it went wrong, date tickets on an agenda, and set rules the agent cannot ignore — what was merged on Ponos's main this week.

entry.title: One ticket, step by step: from a written brief to a reviewed pull request with Claude Code
entry.summary: A worked example on a demo board — how to write a ticket Claude Code can finish alone, what Ponos does while the session runs, what the self-review catches, and the single gesture that ships it.

entry.title: A faster console: windows that open at once, a table that draws only what you see
entry.summary: Ponos 0.3 makes its console quicker where it counts — the windows, the ticket table, long conversations and the dashboard — with the timings we measured before and after, and the two libraries it now builds on.

entry.title: Run your backlog from Claude: Ponos's MCP now manages projects, goals and recurrences
entry.summary: Ponos's MCP connector can now create projects, goals and recurring tickets, tie tasks to a goal and launch them after a cost preview — all through the console's own rules, and never deleting anything.

entry.title: Write the ticket, it comes back done: how Ponos runs Claude Code on your backlog
entry.summary: Ponos turns a ticket moved to Ready into a Claude Code session on a disposable git worktree, and brings it back as a pull request. Here is the loop, step by step.
